questions_to_ask: What is the maximum capacity and is there a curfew or sound ordinance?
Are we required to use your preferred vendor list, or may we bring outside vendors?
What is the weather contingency plan for outdoor spaces?
What setup and breakdown windows are provided before and after the event?
wedding.notes: Verify parking permits and bridal suite access hours

questions_to_ask: Do you provide a formal tasting session prior to contract signing?
How do you handle dietary restrictions, allergies, and kid's meals?
Is alcohol BYO or must it be purchased through your bar package?
What is your ratio of servers/bartenders to guests?
wedding.notes: Ask about vendor meals for photographer/band

questions_to_ask: How many hours of coverage are included and do you bring a second shooter?
What is your backup equipment protocol if a camera or drive fails?
What is the expected turnaround time for sneak peeks and the full gallery?
Do we receive full personal printing rights to the high-resolution files?
wedding.notes: Prepare a family shot list 3 weeks prior

questions_to_ask: Can you repurpose ceremony flowers (arches, aisle bouquets) to the reception?
Do you provide candle holders, pedestals, and arch hardware, or do we rent them?
Will your team handle day-of setup and post-event teardown/donation?
wedding.notes: Share mood board and color swatches

questions_to_ask: Do you provide wireless microphones for the ceremony and speeches?
How do you handle guest song requests and do-not-play lists?
What backup sound equipment do you carry on-site?
wedding.notes: Submit first dance and processional songs

questions_to_ask: How early can we arrive to set up decorations and balloons?
Are candles, sparklers, and confetti permitted on the premises?
Is there a dedicated refrigerator or freezer space for the cake and ice?
Can you accommodate our custom cake flavor and themed design?
Do you deliver and set up the cake at the venue, or is it pickup only?
Do you provide gluten-free, nut-free, or vegan cupcake options?
What age group is your performance or activity geared towards?
Do you supply all materials/props or does the host provide anything?
What space dimensions and electrical outlets do you require?
Does the booth offer instant digital SMS delivery and physical strip prints?
Can you customize the print template with the birthday name and theme?
Is an on-site booth attendant included for the duration of the party?
What special event permits (amplified sound, food handling, tenting) are required?
Are off-duty police officers or private security mandatory for our expected headcount?
What emergency medical services (EMS) or first aid coverage is required?
Do your food trucks operate self-powered or require electrical shore power?
Do you possess valid health department certificates and commercial insurance?
Can you provide a fast-service menu to minimize queue times?
community.notes: Designate dedicated food truck staging zones

questions_to_ask: Does the PA system adequately cover the full outdoor audience radius?
Do you provide a qualified on-site sound engineer throughout all performances?
What power generator capacity is included in the package?
How many ADA-compliant portable restrooms and handwash stations are recommended?
When will delivery and post-event removal take place?
Do you provide trash receptacles, recycling bins, and dumpster service?
community.notes: Place near main entrances and away from food trucks
